This is a question about a state model, so it takes the logic branch: one self-contained
HTML page that anyone can open by double-click and drive with buttons.

File: sample-state-prototype.html, next to the code it prototypes for.

- A <script> block holding a pure reducer, (state, action) => state, with the states
  received, sequenced, qc_pass and qc_fail, and a rerun counter capped at two.
- A current-state panel, re-rendered after every click.
- Free-play buttons: Receive, Sequence, QC pass, QC fail, Rerun.
- Guided walkthroughs, one tab each: the happy path; two failed reruns and then a refused
  third; a pass followed by a failed rerun that must leave the pass in place.

Once it answers the question, the reducer lifts into the real code and the page goes to a
throwaway branch.
